verified_points: Read all requested documents, current Python modules, tests, metrics, audit, and first-review verdict locally. No repository files, product design, commits, or remote state were changed. Generated files were confined to temporary directories.

All 51 current tests passed with python -B. A fresh temporary-directory run reproduced metrics.json exactly, including SHA-256 7ae9517f8c5c3bbc2bbad7702f94ab2934cf824a0a160339e3885e278898e84b. RESULTS.md and all 59 generated fixture files matched the repository artifacts.

Fixture expected bodies and gold spans are independent of extract_body. Deleting the deadline in memory reduced exact extraction from 40/40 to 39/40 and decision-relevant preservation from 12/12 to 11/12. Deleting labeled new content reduced its preservation from 4/4 to 3/4.

Strict E2 evaluates every predicted occurrence through one-to-one gold assignment. Structural accepted attribution error is 0/12. Reuse-augmented accepted attribution error is 4/18; all four errors are accepted attributions on unmatched predictions.

Both strict E2 detection and matching use prior-arrival source context. Every recorded candidate belongs to the independently checked prior-arrival source set. Corrupting all gold marker-style labels left both strict end-to-end result objects unchanged.
Gold-conditioned final-context source and boundary diagnostics are explicitly separated from arrival-time end-to-end results.

E4 uses different authored calibration and holdout templates. Independent comparisons found zero overlapping complete inputs, quote strings, or source-text strings. The threshold of 0.90 is selected using calibration examples only.

E3 assessments retain occurrence spans. Dropping one inline prediction reduced occurrence recall from 26/30 to 25/30 and source-policy recall from 24/30 to 23/30. Duplicating a prediction reduced occurrence precision to 26/27 and produced one false resolved unmatched prediction.

Unexpected parent and ancestry assessments reduced their respective precision to 21/22 and 2/3. Removed-relation history is detectable. Direct parent and indirect ancestry remain separate. A duplicate-ID replay changed a parent assessment from resolved to ambiguous when the conflicting identifier arrived.
Composite multiple-parent quotation gold now consists of two source-specific occurrences. Only the boilerplate alternative-source case is counted as ambiguous.

The duplicate Message-ID comparator claim is supported for the tested orders: final-state agreement is 2/3 for the unsafe comparator and 1 for the ambiguity-preserving comparator. Strict E2 directly records two reverse-provenance errors and two repeated-boilerplate false attributions.

Production accuracy, production representativeness, architecture approval, and literature exhaustion are not claimed. A2 and A7 remain open with bounded non-trigger decisions. Topic 03/04/10 and E5/E6 handoffs remain consistent with the Round 2 decision and design boundaries.
No current headline numerical result was found materially invalid. Acceptance is limited to the stated synthetic engineering-validation scope.
